title: Stasis & Vellum
description: A dark hooded figure stands in the open doorway of a dilapidated magical shop during a heavy rainstorm at night. The storefront is covered in peeling posters, glowing blue potion bottles, white vines, and a large weathered sign reading 'Stasis & Vellum - Spells for the Locked Hour'.
prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy scene of a mysterious hooded figure in a black cloak standing in the doorway of a decaying magical shop at night. Heavy rain pours down from a stormy sky. The shop facade is covered in peeling blue posters, glowing blue potion bottles hanging like lanterns, white flowering vines, and scattered old scrolls. A large wooden sign above the door reads 'Stasis & Vellum - Spells for the Locked Hour'. Water floods the cobblestone street. Moody atmospheric lighting, detailed textures, dramatic lighting.
